description:
Build the "Mission Control" dashboard — the hero system overview page.

**Theme: Ground Control**
Dark background with subtle animated star field particle effect. Electric blue primary accent. Mission control panel aesthetic (NASA JPL modernized). Clean monospace typography for hero KPIs. Subtle grid lines. Velocity chart rendered as trajectory arc.

**Metrics — Available Now (dataSource: live):**
- Total scenarios count and running/stopped breakdown (Vrooli /scenarios API)
- Scenario health status summary (healthy/degraded/down counts)
- Backlog size (Swarm DashboardStats.TotalBacklogSize)
- Velocity trend — 8-week sparkline (DashboardStats.VelocityTrend)
- Estimated weeks remaining (DashboardStats.EstimatedWeeksRemaining)
- Total completed all-time (DashboardStats.TotalCompletedAllTime)
- Active executions / max concurrent (GovernanceStatus)
- Queue depth (GovernanceStatus.QueueDepth)
- Items completed this week (ThroughputStats.CompletedLast7Days)
- Net backlog delta 7-day (ThroughputStats.NetDelta7Days)

**Metrics — Ideal/Future (dataSource: gap):**
- Total revenue (MRR/ARR) as hero number
- Total users across all bundles
- "Compound intelligence" counter — cumulative scenarios completed + capabilities added over time
- System uptime percentage
- Live activity feed (cross-system events: new subscriber, scenario deployed, backlog item completed)

**Layout concept:** Large hero KPIs across the top (2-3 massive monospace numbers), velocity trend chart in the center styled as trajectory arc, grid of secondary metrics below, subtle activity ticker at the bottom.
name: command-center-mission-control-page
title: Build Mission Control dashboard — system overview with Ground Control theme
